metric_definitions.raw_dot_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative embedding dot-product score before transition evidence.
metric_definitions.raw_dot_margin_count: Number of scalar observations used for raw_dot_margin.
metric_definitions.complete_score_margin: Mean positive-minus-negative complete score using each training user's excluded-fold graph.
metric_definitions.complete_score_margin_count: Number of scalar observations used for complete_score_margin.
metric_definitions.context_coverage: Mean recency-weighted share of context sources with retained outgoing edges in the user-excluding graph.
metric_definitions.context_coverage_count: Number of scalar observations used for context_coverage.
metric_definitions.positive_edge_coverage: Fraction of sampled positive targets with a retained edge from at least one recent context item.
metric_definitions.positive_edge_coverage_count: Number of scalar observations used for positive_edge_coverage.
metric_definitions.absolute_residual: Mean absolute pooled transition residual before multiplication by the learned gate, across positive and negative candidates.
metric_definitions.absolute_residual_count: Number of scalar observations used for absolute_residual.
metric_definitions.deployment_training_residual_MAE: Mean absolute difference between deployment-average residual and user-excluding residual on sampled training positions; this is a training-side distribution-shift diagnostic.
metric_definitions.deployment_training_residual_MAE_count: Number of scalar observations used for deployment_training_residual_MAE.
metric_definitions.singleton_user_support_margin: Mean complete margin where the maximum distinct-other-user support among retained positive-target context edges is exactly one.
metric_definitions.multiple_user_support_margin: Mean complete margin where at least one retained positive-target context edge has support from two or more distinct other training users.
metric_definitions.multiple_user_support_margin_count: Number of scalar observations used for multiple_user_support_margin.
metric_definitions.embedding_cosine_mean: Mean cosine similarity of seed-42 sampled distinct nonpadding item pairs; alone this does not establish embedding collapse.
metric_definitions.embedding_cosine_std: Population standard deviation of the sampled pair cosine similarities.
metric_definitions.sampled_positions: Number of supervised positions measured from at most four batches and 512 positions per batch.
metric_definitions.unresolved_training_rows: Rows excluded because their exact sampled training history could not be assigned unambiguously to a user fold.

unavailable.singleton_user_support_margin: No eligible observations in the bounded diagnostic sample.
unavailable.category_breakdown: Item category metadata is unavailable in this matched task.
unavailable.review_preferences: Review ratings and text are unavailable.
unavailable.simulator_traits: Diversity and conformity traits are unobserved.

limitations: Only public training histories contribute to transition graphs.
Diagnostics use a bounded training sample and do not establish validation improvement.
Distinct-user support is per directed edge, not a union of users across context edges.
Validation JSON records constituent-fold versus deployment score shift and HR@10 on fixed validation candidates.
The host independently computes the benchmark selection metric.
